## Governance and security

- [ ] New framework conventions cite a dated official primary source and include canonical fixtures.
- [ ] Paths, symlinks, subprocesses, output limits, and secrets were considered where relevant.
- [ ] No prompts, conversations, credentials, private repository data, or inferred producer metadata are included.
